mn3:6.15: ‘The disciples of a Teacher who lives in seclusion do not train in seclusion.’
mn3:6.16: This is the first ground on which the junior mendicants should be criticized.
mn3:6.17: ‘They don’t give up what the Teacher tells them to give up.’
mn3:6.18: This is the second ground on which the junior mendicants should be criticized.
mn3:6.19: ‘They’re indulgent and slack, leaders in backsliding, neglecting seclusion.’
mn3:6.20: This is the third ground on which the junior mendicants should be criticized.
mn3:6.21: The junior mendicants should be criticized on these three grounds.
mn3:7.15: ‘The disciples of a Teacher who lives in seclusion train in seclusion.’
mn3:7.16: This is the first ground on which the junior mendicants should be praised.
mn3:7.17: ‘They give up what the Teacher tells them to give up.’
mn3:7.18: This is the second ground on which the junior mendicants should be praised.
mn3:7.19: ‘They’re not indulgent and slack, leaders in backsliding, neglecting seclusion.’
mn3:7.20: This is the third ground on which the junior mendicants should be praised.
mn3:7.21: The junior mendicants should be praised on these three grounds.
mn3:9-15.15: Heirs in the Teaching is finished—the third.
